__about: Where an ambiguous en.json key appears in the UI. translate.py sends the note with the string; only the key is translated. Add an entry whenever a short key can be read two ways.
Install: Button / action verb (start installing a package, theme or update). Imperative, not the noun 'installation'.
Target: Where something goes: the storage a package installs to (shown as 'Target: SD card' in the install queue) and which Home Menu part a theme replaces. Not 'layout'.
Target:: Label before the install destination storage in the install queue.
Legacy: App Store filter: old apps that are no longer maintained.
HB Menu: Name of a list layout styled like the classic Homebrew Menu (hbmenu). Brand-like; usually keep as 'HB Menu'.
Options: Title of the options side panel opened with the + button inside a screen. Must differ from 'Settings' (the app settings screen).
Settings: The application settings screen (a tile in the Tools hub). Must differ from 'Options'.
Layout: How a list is drawn: list, icons or grid.
Enable sysMMC: Switch: allow installing games while running sysMMC (the console's internal system). Infinitive/toggle label, not an instruction.
Enable emuMMC: Switch: allow installing games while running emuMMC (the emulated system on the microSD card). Infinitive/toggle label, not an instruction.
Kefir Settings: Settings of the Kefir CFW pack (overclock, memory patches). 'Kefir' is a brand name: keep it, capitalized, not declined.
Kefir Hub: Brand name of this app. Never translate.
Folders First: Sort option: list folders before files.
Home Menu: The Nintendo Switch system HOME Menu.
Dump: Verb/action: export a game or card to a file.
Mount: Make a drive or folder available (USB drive, MTP, network share).
Restore: Put a save or backup back onto the console.
Sources: Places the file browser can open: microSD card, USB drives, network locations.
